thesis: This episode argues that successful technology products are often defined by executing features at a 10x level of quality rather than being the first to invent them, citing examples like Apple with Face ID and Tesla with electric cars. The speaker emphasizes that Superhuman is the first to execute productivity features at this 10x level, specifically allowing users to set reminders without touching the mouse or by typing a few characters. The core thesis is that what users feel (joy) and the software form are as important as the features themselves.
